headline: Jefferies posts a record quarter on banking and equities
summary_short: Total revenue rose 25.0% y/y to $3,118M in fiscal Q2 2026, and pretax income surged 133.9% y/y to $315.5M as investment banking (+57.5% y/y) and equities set quarterly records; net earnings attributable to Jefferies rose 157.8% y/y to $255.4M.
summary_long: Investment banking net revenues rose 57.5% y/y to $1.21B, with advisory posting its best quarter ever ($674.1M, +47.2% y/y) on market-share gains, while equity underwriting more than doubled and debt underwriting declined on lower deal values. Equities net revenues hit a quarterly record of $600.8M (+14.2% y/y) on higher trading volumes and expanding prime services; fixed income rose 11.6% y/y to $198.5M. Net revenues (total revenue less interest expense) were $2.21B, up 35.0% y/y. Non-interest expenses rose 26.1% y/y on higher compensation. The effective tax rate fell to 20.8% from 32.3% on investment tax credits. Jefferies repurchased $371.7M of stock and paid a $0.40/share dividend in H1; leverage ratio was 7.5x. No forward guidance was given.
